title: Cops rescue 16-year-old girl allegedly held over debt in Leyte

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — After responding to an emergency 911 call, police officers rescued a 16-year-old girl who was allegedly prevented from leaving her companions because of an outstanding debt in Barangay Guindapunan, Palo, Leyte, on Sunday. The Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) said personnel from the Palo Municipal Police Station and the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) assisted the minor. Initial police investigation showed that the girl traveled from Agusan del Sur to Leyte on Oct. 30 with two female companions in search of employment.
